events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare live plists to repo copies, scan for secrets, check remotes
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; wc -l workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md workshop-plan/ops/up.sh; echo ---LIVE; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -c . ; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents; echo ---DIFF; for f in ~/Library/LaunchAgents/*.plist; do b=$(basename $f); r=$(ls workshop-plan/ops/$b workshop-plan/ops/launchd/$b 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$r" ]; then echo "NOCOPY $b"; elif ! cmp -s $f $r; then echo "DIFFERS $b"; fi; done; echo ---REPO-ONLY; for r in workshop-plan/ops/*.plist workshop-plan/ops/launchd/*.plist; do [ -f ~/Library/LaunchAgents/$(basename $r) ] || echo "repo-only $r"; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scan plist copies for secret values and summarise each job's program, schedule and env keys
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/ops; echo ---SECRET-SCAN; grep -nE '<string>[^<]*</string>' *.plist launchd/*.plist | grep -Ei 'sk_|whsec|bearer|eyJ|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}|password|apikey|api_key' | cut -c1-220; echo ---ENVKEYS; for f in *.plist launchd/*.plist; do python3 - "$f" <<'EOF'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run up.sh and up.sh --check and show results
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; workshop-plan/ops/up.sh > /tmp/t006-up.txt 2>&1; echo "up exit $?"; cat /tmp/t006-up.txt; workshop-plan/ops/up.sh --check > /tmp/t006-check.txt 2>&1; echo "check exit $?"; grep -E 'WARN|FAIL|summary' /tmp/t006-check.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect centre-sheet log, worktree layout, dash scan, git state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; tail -5 /tmp/centre-sheet.log | cut -c1-300; echo ---; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2 remote -v | head -1; git worktree list | head -8; echo ---; grep -n 'urlopen\|admin\|401\|key\|KEY' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2/workshop-plan/ops/centre_sheet.py | cut -c1-200 | head -30; echo; LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 grep -n '[–—]' workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md workshop-plan/ops/up.sh | head -5; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; git log origin/main --oneline -1
